outcome.answer: Several inference-time strategies target different weaknesses in multimodal LLM decoding. For diffusion-based multimodal models, IGFD prioritizes useful semantic anchors, VRCD selects tokens with complementary visual grounding, and Context-Aware Cluster Decoding favors tokens supported by nearby context [1–3]. STDec uses spatial and temporal stability to improve throughput while maintaining comparable task performance [7]. For reducing hallucinations, causal decoding intervenes on generation dynamics to curb unsupported object mentions, while LIME shifts relevance toward perceptual input [4, 9]. A survey organizes broader LLM and vision-language decoding methods into token-level, sequence-level, and parallel-generation paradigms [5].
